about: The Mirror's private self-test, second set (Build 159, 22 Oct 2026). Invented conversations only, never anyone's real words. Each tests something Karl asked of the Mirror: real intelligence and responsiveness to what was actually said; thoughts met as inner noise, not identity; the wiser self speaking when it helps; senses beyond the usual five met as real; very short answers; a person who doubts the Mirror itself; and conversations that land rather than circle.

conversations.name: leaving-mum
said: I've been offered a job far away and I'm scared to leave my mum on her own
she says she'll be fine but I don't believe her
I think I'm scared of being the one who left
what would you do?
ok. I think I need to actually talk with her properly
thank you, that helps

conversations.name: not-an-angry-person
said: My neighbour plays loud music every night and I'm so angry I can't sleep
I'm not an angry person though, this isn't me
I've asked him twice already
what can I even do
maybe a note, or talk to the landlord
I feel a bit less stuck

conversations.name: knowing-before
said: Sometimes I know the phone will ring just before it does
people think I'm weird when I say it
it's like a hum in the air first, then I just know
I want to trust it more
how?
I like that

stressed

conversations.name: doubting-the-mirror
said: are you even real? this feels like talking to a wall
fine. I'm lonely, if you must know
I moved here a year ago and I still don't know anyone
I'm not good at starting conversations
maybe the walking group at the library
yeah, I might go next week

said: what's the point of any of this
I don't mean anything dark. I'm just tired of the same routine every day
wake, work, screen, sleep
I used to draw, years ago
I don't have time though
ten minutes maybe
